reviews.text: They are sensational and impeccable in their care for our beloved pets. Throughout the time they were looking after my cats, they kept me informed with videos, pictures, and messages simultaneously. This made me feel much more at ease from a distance! I wholeheartedly recommend their services. Thank you!
Malu took great care of our kittens. I highly recommend her!

This was my first experience with a petsitting service and I was genuinely impressed by Márcia's professionalism, attention, and care. I highly recommend her and will certainly use her services again.

Maggie was looked after by Márcia during the holidays and she was impeccable! Communication was always very easy and we received updates and photos every day, which put me at ease. She even helped me with the plants, which was a very kind extra. I recommend her without hesitation. Thank you for everything, Márcia!

I loved the service; my cats Puka and Minnie were very well taken care of by the kind and attentive Lúcia. The visits are daily, accompanied by videos, photos, and written reports, and I found the regularity of the visit time very interesting. Márcia also took care of my plants, and there are many. I can only thank her and recommend her excellent service. My girls and I spent a week apart but very peacefully 🥰 Thank you, Lúcia.

I recommend Malü 100%! She took care of my two cats for a week while I was on vacation, and I couldn't have been happier.

From the first contact, she demonstrated enormous professionalism, kindness, and genuine affection for animals. Every day she sent me photos, videos, and messages telling me how they were doing, which gave me immense peace of mind and allowed me to enjoy my vacation without worries.

When I returned home, I found my cats calm, happy, and very well cared for. It's clear that Malü does this work with dedication, responsibility, and a lot of love for animals.

If you are looking for someone trustworthy to take care of your pets, I recommend her services without any hesitation. I will certainly use her services again.
Great service. My pet was well taken care of and I had no worries while I was away. Would recommend and will use again.
Finding Malu was a balm to my heart. She took wonderful care of my cats and sent me lots of photos and videos, which I loved! A very lovely and extremely trustworthy person.
It was an incredible experience!! Márcia and Pedro were always spectacular and took the utmost care!! Thank you ❤️

Kelly spent a week with Márcia and Pedro, and it couldn't have gone better! To say it was fantastic is an understatement; great professionalism combined with an excellent family atmosphere. Kelly felt at home, and we felt like we were always close to Kelly. Thank you so much 🙏 …

I've never felt so at ease leaving my cat with someone!
The service included a free visit from Márcia to our home, where she showed great interest in meeting our kitten and asked several questions to help us in the best way possible.
Márcia is super organized, sends many photos and videos of each visit, and always described our kitten's state of mind!
Without a doubt, Beirão loved Márcia (and so did we 🥰). You can tell that Márcia really likes animals, and I can only thank her for all the care, for being able to help us with such short notice, and for helping us make the most of our peaceful vacation 🥹🥰
Márcia was very attentive and made my kitten very comfortable; impeccable service.

Marcia has looked after our cats a few times since March; she's super friendly and takes great care of them. She sends us lots of updates and is very responsible and attentive to the kittens. Our cats are shy, but Marcia makes them feel comfortable and plays with them. Thank you, Marcia, as always 😊 …

Marcia and Pedro are very professional, patient, and caring with my dog, and they are the only people I trust to look after Ollie! I've known them for over 2 years and highly recommend them. I trust them completely 😍 …
Great cat sitter! Malu took wonderful care of our 3-month-old kitten while we were away.
It went spectacularly. Márcia is a great pet sitter, very careful with the cat. The cat adored her. Everything went very well and she even did the favor of watering the plants. Thank you, Márcia.

First expérience with Marcia. She took really good care of this shy hissing monster named Guizmo.
We appreciated the daily photoshoot update and we will use this service again.

Muito obrigado

I'm so happy to have found someone like Márcia! She's super professional, organized, and friendly. She exudes calmness and cordiality, which is perfect for me and especially for my cat. The daily updates with photos and videos put me at ease. I highly recommend Malu Pet Care's Petsitting services!
Marcia was fantastic in taking care of our kitten!! Very professional and caring, she sent us photos and videos every day she was here. I highly recommend her!!

For 10 days, Márcia was responsible for visiting my two cats, and I wouldn't hesitate to repeat the experience. She's an excellent professional, and you can clearly see the care and love she has for animals. She always left everything spotless and sent photos and videos daily. I recommend Márcia 100% to anyone needing pet sitting services!

We left our keys with Marcia during our 4-day vacation, and she was amazing! She fed and walked our English Setters twice a day, every morning and evening. She kept us updated with daily photos, which was so helpful and reassuring. I want to thank her again for all her help. I highly recommend her services to everyone with peace of mind. She is very kind and friendly, but most importantly, she is truly reliable and experienced. Thanks a million, Marcia!
Marcia was amazing with my kittens, they're in the right hands!
Thank you Ana! ☺️

My little Megan was treated incredibly well and pampered during the days I was away from home. I received photos and videos and could see that she was super happy and calm, so I was also very calm even though I was far away. I am immensely grateful for Márcia's service; she is a very kind and skilled person with pets. I will definitely call her again, after all, Megan has now made another friend :) !!

I left Marly, my dog, in someone's care for 5 days for the first time and I was able to stay calm the whole time. I received photos and videos with each visit. There were walks, playtime, and feeding was also taken care of by Márcia.
My kittens received affection and the necessary care, including cleaning the litter box and feeding.
Leaving our animals with someone is a concern, but this only existed before I left. During my trip, I was able to stay calm thanks to the confidence they instilled in me from day one. Thank you very much.

Marcia took care of our cat during our vacation, and she did an excellent job. We were very satisfied.
We recommend her, and we will definitely use her valuable help again!
Everything was great!!
Marcia took such loving care of my two cats and kept me updated regularly. I always felt they were in good hands, which allowed me to truly enjoy my time away without any worries. 🐱 …
Thank you, Margarida!

Absolutely amazing service! Márcia (the lovely owner) has been petsitting for our cat for the last 3 or 4 times we’ve been out of town. She even helped us when it was super urgent!
The business is very reliable, attentive to details, well organized and friendly. Each visit is accompanied by photos and videos, as well as some description of the pet’s condition (if they are happy or tired, if they have eaten or went to the toilet).
Moreover, our cat, being very shy, has truly opened up to Márcia, he’s very happy to see her every time and he is visibly comfortable with her. What could be more important than that!
I should add to this that Malü was petsitting with our cat during blackout in April 2025, and even this didn’t break the schedule, so the business has proven to be reliable even in unpredictable circumstances.
So, this is truly the best experience we’ve ever had with a pet sitter. We are happy every time we’re doing business with Malü, and this is definitely the place to go for this service! Thank you very much for our happy cat♥️♥️♥️

I highly recommend Malu Petsitter's services. Márcia took care of my two cats with great affection and attention, always demonstrating responsibility and love for animals. Communication was constant and gave me complete confidence throughout the time I was away. I felt very reassured knowing my cats were in good hands.

We were away for 5 days and hired their service to take care of our two cats. They were extremely attentive, took great care of our pets, and always sent updates and photos. We arrived and our pets were fine!! I highly recommend them; we were able to travel with peace of mind!

Excellent service, very professional, and without complications or judgments. It was our first time using a pet sitter and we were completely won over. Our dog was very well cared for, with lots of affection and kindness. Our medium-sized dog is very timid and doesn't like strangers (barks a lot and moves away), but Márcia easily managed her "personality," demonstrating ease and experience. She is attentive, practical, and responsible; we were very satisfied - we recommend her 100%!!

I couldn't recommend Malu more!
For a week she walked my dog ​​twice a day, and it was a relief for the whole family who were away.
Always attentive and very present, with feedback and photos after each walk, and always respecting Snoopy's wishes.
We will certainly always turn to her when we need to!
We loved it, and Snoopy even more :)
I have nothing but good things to say. Impeccable service, regular communication, great friendliness and availability!
They took excellent care of my cat Eros, always sending photos and updates during each visit. I was able to travel without any worries. I highly recommend their service!

My little boy Keiko was in love with Pedro and his dogs from the moment they met. Keiko is not always taken by anyone and his body language always shows me when he isn’t comfortable with someone or with a place. With Pedro and Malüpet he was happy, calm, playful and comfortable. More importantly Pedro showed a lot of professionalism and kindness and care, he took good care of all my notes and I was grateful for that. I will certainly use the service again.

We have always had an excellent experience with the pet sitting. Márcia is lovely, and she is wonderful with our cat. She comes to visit him, plays with him and sends us photos and videos. She obviously deeply cares about animals, and it is great to know that our cat is in great hands. Very highly recommended! :)

Marcia took excellent care of my cat over the Christmas holidays! She is very reliable and responsive and would 100 percent use her services again, as well as recommend to anyone who needs a catsitter.
Amazing service. From the very first minute, they were very helpful and inspired confidence. I recommend them to anyone who needs their services!

We hired the petsitting service for two days and one night. Messages and videos were sent throughout the days with updates about our puppy, and he came home tired but happy! Thank you, Márcia, for taking such good care of our little one! We recommend them 100%!
Thanks
Affection, dedication, trust, professionalism - and absolute peace of mind regarding the well-being of my beloved four-legged friend in my absence. Márcia is tireless... 5 stars!
Our Júlia was wonderfully taken care of by Márcia during our vacation. I've never felt so relaxed. I received photos and videos every day, and I'm sure I'll use Malü again next time 🥰 …
Excellent! We feel very reassured!

She is a super attentive person with our babies, we loved how she took care of them on this day, a thank you is not enough.
Always concerned about telling us how they were doing and always sending photos and videos 10 stars

My husband and I decided to have a pet-friendly wedding, so we hired Márcia to take care of our four-legged baby and his friends. Everything went very well, Márcia was super caring and attentive, and you can tell she loves what she does. I recommend her 200%, thank you so much for everything! ☺️☺️

We have already requested Márcia from Malü Pet Care for pet sitting twice, and both times we were extremely satisfied. She sent us daily photo and video updates, took great care of our cats, and kept the apartment clean.
I recommend them 100%!!!! The care they provide, both in treating the dogs and in communicating with them, is excellent! 100% trustworthy!!!

Our experience with Malü pet care was incredible! We felt that our babies were very well looked after, and Márcia was constantly sending photos and updates. It was a relief to know that they were in good hands.
In addition, Malü pet care even allowed us to have our furry friends at our wedding!

I highly recommend them!!!
